verdict_reason: The diff itself (package rename plus @EnableMongoAuditing) is correct and covered by an IT, but enabling auditing without a companion @Version on Address leaves update/delete as last-write-wins read-modify-write.

todos.issue: The PR adds @EnableMongoAuditing here, which turns on @CreatedDate/@LastModifiedDate but NOT optimistic locking — Address has no @Version field, so OperatorService.update() and delete() are unguarded read-modify-write full-document save() calls (last-write-wins; a concurrent delete can be resurrected by an in-flight PUT). Corroborates the open cross-file finding on Address.java.
todos.fix: Add a @Version Long field to Address so Spring Data emits a version-predicated update, and map the resulting OptimisticLockingFailureException to 409 in GlobalExceptionHandler (or switch update/delete to a targeted findAndModify with a status/version predicate instead of save()).
